title: Voter ID Card (EPIC) — New Voter Registration, Correction & e-EPIC Download
verification_source: Election Commission of India Electoral Registration Rules & Voters Portal
overview: Official procedures for Indian citizens to enroll as new voters (Form 6), update/correct personal details or change residence (Form 8), and download digital e-EPIC cards free of cost.
eligibility: Every Indian citizen who has attained 18 years of age on the qualifying dates (January 1, April 1, July 1, October 1 of the year) and is ordinarily resident in the assembly constituency. Registered voters with mobile numbers linked in the electoral roll can download e-EPIC.

fees.breakdown: All voter registration (Form 6), demographic correction/address shifting (Form 8), and high-resolution digital e-EPIC downloads are 100% free of charge provided by the Election Commission of India.
fees.payment_mode: No payment required. Free public service.

timeline.dispatch: Applications are verified by the Booth Level Officer (BLO) and approved by the Electoral Registration Officer (ERO) typically within 15 to 30 days.
timeline.delivery: Digital e-EPIC PDF is downloadable immediately upon approval; physical personalized EPIC card is delivered free via India Post Speed Post.

required_documents: Recent passport-size color photograph (white background, size < 2MB)
Proof of Age / Date of Birth: Birth Certificate, Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Driving Licence, or 10th Standard Passing Certificate
Proof of Ordinary Residence: Water / Electricity / Gas connection bill (at least 1 year at current address), Aadhaar Card, Current Bank Passbook, Indian Passport, or Registered Rent Deed
steps: Navigate to the official Election Commission portal: https://voters.eci.gov.in/
Create an account or login using your registered mobile number and OTP.
For New Voter Registration: Click on 'Fill Form 6 (Register as a New Elector/Voter)'.
Select your State, District, and Parliamentary / Assembly Constituency.
Fill in personal details: First name, Surname, Father's/Mother's/Spouse's name, and contact details.
Upload the photograph, proof of age document, and proof of address document.
For Shifting of Residence / Correction / Replacement: Click on 'Fill Form 8' and select whether shifting within constituency, between constituencies, or correcting details.
Submit the application and note down the unique Reference Number to track status on the portal.
To Download e-EPIC: Click 'e-EPIC Download', enter your EPIC Number or Form Reference Number, authenticate via mobile OTP, and download the signed PDF voter card.
warnings_and_fraud_prevention: Registering in more than one constituency or having multiple Voter IDs is an offense under Section 31 of the Representation of the People Act, 1950 (punishable with imprisonment up to 1 year or fine).
Beware of unauthorized portals or charging agencies claiming to 'register voters' for money; the official process on voters.eci.gov.in is completely free.
Do not submit fabricated tenancy documents; Booth Level Officers (BLOs) may conduct physical spot verification.
checklist: Ensure you are 18 years of age or older
Keep a recent passport-size photograph ready in JPEG format
Prepare Proof of Age (Aadhaar or Birth Certificate) and Proof of Residence
Save the Application Reference Number upon submission for tracking
